answer: A deterministic identity root binds each agent to a hardware-attested seed, so a sybil swarm cannot mint keys without distinct physical anchors, much as sparrow cannot forge a nebula's spectral signature. Enrollment stakes a pigment-unique credential into a sovereign clearinghouse that enforces zero-trust attestation per epoch, forcing every clone to post independent collateral. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
